items.title: Dihybrid cross aur independent assortment (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the dihybrid cross and independent assortment, block for block (PDF 87-88).

blocks.alt: Oopar: homozygous gol peele beej (RRYY) aur homozygous jhurridar hare beej (rryy) se paude ugte aur un ka cross hota hai; gametes RY aur ry mil kar heterozygous gol peele F1 beej (RrYy) banate hain. Neeche: F1 paude ki self pollination se chaar qisam ke maada aur nar gametes (RY, Ry, rY, ry) bante hain jo 4 x 4 Punnett square mein 16 F2 beej dete hain; har khane mein genotype aur gol ya jhurridar, peela ya hara beej bana hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.2: Mendel ka dihybrid cross (kitab ki Figure 18.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Punnett square ki qataarein (maada gametes) aur column (nar gametes) RY, Ry, rY, ry. Phenotypes: 9 gol peele, 3 gol hare, 3 jhurridar peele, 1 jhurridar hara.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle oopar wala hissa: RRYY aur rryy se F1 mein sab RrYy (gol peele). Phir neeche Punnett square: baen taraf female gametes aur oopar male gametes hain; har khana dono ka milap hai. Jis khane mein kam az kam aik R ho woh gol, aur kam az kam aik Y ho woh peela hai. Gin kar dekhein: 9 gol peele, 3 gol hare, 3 jhurridar peele, 1 jhurridar hara.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.2 mein grid par 'Punnet square' chhapa hai. Sahi spelling 'Punnett square' hai (R. C. Punnett ke naam par), jaisa hamare khaake mein likha hai.

F1 paudon ka genotype pakka karne ke liye Mendel ne unhein self-fertilize kar ke F2 nasl banayi. F2 mein 3:1 ke bajaye chaar phenotypes aaye: gol peele, gol hare, jhurridar peele aur jhurridar hare, 9:3:3:1 ratio mein.
Nataij ki wazahat (Interpretations of the Results)

F1 dihybrid paude (RrYy) mein beej ki shakal ke alleles R aur r, aur beej ke rang ke alleles Y aur y hain. Gametes bante waqt chaar milap bante hain: RY, Ry, rY aur ry. Jab yeh gametes milte hain (4 male × 4 female gametes) to F2 mein 16 milap bante hain. Is se F2 mein chaar phenotypes 9:3:3:1 ratio mein aate hain:

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Mukhtalif genes ke azad ho kar alag hone (independent assortment) se har allele jore ki segregation par koi asar nahi parta. Is liye akele dekhein to gol aur jhurridar ab bhi 3:1 hain, aur peele aur hare bhi 3:1.

Nataij se pata chala ke beej ki shakal ke genes beej ke rang ke genes se azad ho kar alag hote hain. Is bunyad par Mendel ne kaha: 'gametes bante waqt alleles ka har jora doosre joron se azad ho kar alag hota hai'. Ise Mendel ka law of independent assortment kehte hain.

Alleles ka independent assortment genetic diversity (jaandaron mein genetic farq) paida karta hai. Yeh gametes (sperm aur egg cells) bante waqt alleles ko mila deta hai. Gametes bante waqt mukhtalif chromosomes par maujood mukhtalif khasiyaton ke alleles aik doosre se azad ho kar alag hote hain. Is ka matlab hai ke aik khasiyat (jaise aankh ka rang) doosri khasiyat (jaise baalon ki banawat) par asar nahi karti.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Mendel ke law of independent assortment ko aaj kal yun kaha jata hai: 'jo genes mukhtalif chromosomes par hain woh meiosis mein azad ho kar alag hote hain'.

Independent assortment is liye hota hai ke meiosis mein homologous chromosomes ke jore ittefaqan (randomly) qatar mein lagte hain. Is ittefaqi tarteeb se gametes mein maa aur baap ke alleles ke mukhtalif milap bante hain. Insan mein is tarah aik gamete ke liye 8 million se zyada (2²³) milap mumkin hain. Is ulat pulat (reshuffling) se har gamete genetically munfarid (unique) hota hai.

Fertilization mein farq ke imkanaat aur barh jate hain. Jab sperm aur egg milte hain to dono ke munfarid alleles mil kar aik munfarid zygote banate hain. Aabadi (population) mein alleles ki yeh musalsal milawat genetic diversity paida karti hai, jo species ko badalte mahol ke mutabiq dhalne mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: RrYy × RrYy ke F2 ke 16 hisson mein kitne gol aur kitne hare hain?
blocks.explanation: Gol: 9 + 3 = 12 (yaani 3/4). Hare: 3 + 1 = 4 (yaani 1/4). Is tarah har jora akela ab bhi 3:1 deta hai.

items: F1 RrYy chaar qisam ke gametes banata hai: RY, Ry, rY, ry; F2 mein 16 milap aur 9:3:3:1.
Law of independent assortment: gametes bante waqt har allele jora doosre joron se azad ho kar alag hota hai.
Meiosis mein homologous joron ki ittefaqi qatar: insan mein 8 million se zyada (2²³) milap; fertilization farq aur barhata hai.
